answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to enter through one verified inlet where it locks a deposit before trading. Peers then countersign its work, and a single whisper of fraud, one failed check, freezes the deposit for review. A public beacon lists each agent's standing, so buyers consult it before paying. An attacker spinning up many fake identities must fund each deposit separately and forfeits it when caught, making forgery cost more than it earns, while honest agents keep trading and keep their stake.
